videos.title: UConn SURGES past UCLA, will play Michigan State in Sweet 16 | 2026 March Madness
videos.description: Highlights of UConn's 73–57 win over UCLA (2026 NCAA Second Round) at Xfinity Mobile Arena; uploaded by CBS Sports.

photos.caption: President Joe Biden greets the University of Connecticut Huskies men’s basketball team and University leadership at a White House event to celebrate their 2022-23 NCAA championship, Friday, May 26, 2023, in the State Dining Room of the White House. (Official White House Photo by Cameron Smith)
UConn's Alex Karaban beats the shot clock again with a jumper to extend the Huskies' lead late.
Alex Karaban hits a deep 3 from the logo for UConn vs. Providence.
Alex Karaban fires a deep three from the middle of the arc, igniting the crowd for UConn.
Alex Karaban hits a clutch 3-pointer with under 30 seconds to play as UConn pads its lead vs. Georgetown.
UConn's Alex Karaban beats the first-half buzzer with a contested 3-pointer from the corner.
